entries.description: The viewer owns a Form & Decorate Tech, so they have added the second Form & Decorate space; they have not yet added the second Glaze & Load space. Placement options, quotes and the Commission / Guild / Magistrate option lists are for this exact state.
entries.name: 3P · Round 2 · Work Phase · your turn (before action)

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu was placed at the Commission Market, which opened its Select 3: a private look at the top 3 Main Orders (v1.6.2 L64, L202). own.pendingLook holds the 3 Orders; other players only see counts.pendingLook (kind + count). The viewer now reserves 1 or 2, in any mix of those 3 and the display (SELECT_CHOOSE); a face-up position stays empty until the turn ends, and the looked cards not reserved go face down to the bottom of the Main Order deck (change 24). No resource is gained.
entries.name: 4P · Round 3 · Commission Market · Shifu mid-action with a private Select 3

steered.why: Shifu to the Commission Market: the placement opens the private Select 3.

entries.description: Kiln Die and Base Heat after the revealed Contributions are known; the Fire card is not yet revealed. Face-down Heat markers have no value yet (the viewer turns or returns theirs now). heatPreviews show Actual Heat before Fire and Quality per possible Fire card, null while a face-down marker is still undecided.
entries.name: 3P · Firing · Heat-marker step (step 5)

entries.description: Quality has been assigned. The viewer chooses after-Quality abilities in their own order (Ge Crackle, Protective Saggars, Second Firing), rechecked after each use. heatLadder.chips carries each ceramic's Actual Heat, Heat Difference and Quality.
entries.name: 3P · Firing · after-Quality window (step 10)

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: In a 2-player game the Shared Kiln has 4 active spaces (High 2, Middle 1, Low 1); covered spaces are active:false in boardView.kilnSpaces. The Magistrate's Hall has capacity 1 (kilnLayout.centralCapacities).
entries.name: 2P · Work Phase · 2-1-1 Shared Kiln and 1-space Magistrate's Hall

entries.description: Only held Orders can be completed, in one First-Player-order pass. completableOrders gives one entry per completable held Order (its first match); orderMatchOptions lists every distinct ceramic group with the Crackle declarations that would be recorded; crackleDeclarationChecks run the validator's matcher (orderSelectionCheck) for each Decoration a Crackle ceramic could declare, so a declaration picker never re-implements Order rules.
entries.name: 3P · Order Phase · completable held Orders with Crackle wildcard

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: Cleanup step 2 (Rounds 1–4 only): the viewer holds more than the limit (4, or 5 with Colour Samples) and must discard exactly the excess. The prompt is parallel; other players' hands stay hidden (only counts).
entries.name: 3P · Cleanup · trim Orders to the hand limit

entries.description: FinalResult with each player's breakdown: orders, kilnAbilities, recognitionOverflow, imperialAudience, exhibition (quality VP + Shape/Glaze diversity bonuses), connoisseur, coins, total (Advanced Techs score no VP, v1.6.2 change 27); standings with tie-break values (Recognition, printed Crowns, Masterpieces) and resolvedBy.
entries.name: 4P · Final results

entries.description: Contributions are chosen secretly and simultaneously. phase.submittedPlayerIds shows who has submitted, never what; the viewer's own choice is not yet sealed. contributionOptions lists 1 option per Contribution card the viewer holds: Tend / Bank / Stoke, and Fuel Ledger Bank / Fuel Ledger Stoke when Fuel Ledger is owned (v1.6.2 change 26), with Wood cost (paid on reveal) and affordability.
entries.name: 3P · Firing · step 1 · secret Contributions

steered.why: Apprentice buys T22 so the step-1 fixture can show Fuel Ledger, Inverted Firing or Setter's Mark.
Apprentice buys T12 so the step-1 fixture can show Fuel Ledger, Inverted Firing or Setter's Mark.
Apprentice buys T21 so the step-1 fixture can show Fuel Ledger, Inverted Firing or Setter's Mark.

entries.description: The viewer owns Setter's Mark (T22): at the start of the Work Phase they may place the tile on an empty active Shared Kiln space, or decline (settersMarkOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Start of the Work Phase · Setter's Mark window

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Setter's Mark (T22) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer placed their Setter's Mark: only they may load into that space this round; the tile returns when they load there or at Cleanup.
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · a Setter's Mark tile on a Shared Kiln space

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Setter's Mark (T22) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.
The owner places the Setter's Mark on the first open space.

entries.description: The viewer owns Test Pieces (T13) and has a ceramic in this firing: they may pay 1 Wood to look privately at the top Fire card (testPiecesOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 4 · Test Pieces: pay 1 Wood to peek?

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Test Pieces (T13) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer peeked: only they see the card (own.firePeek). Others see only that they paid and peeked. Next they decide, publicly, whether to bury it.
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 4 · Test Pieces: bury the card?

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Test Pieces (T13) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.
The owner pays 1 Wood and peeks.

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu inspected the top Techs of one discipline: only they see them (guildInspectionOptions). They take up to 2 Techs from different disciplines, inspected or face-up, each at its printed cost (v1.6.2 L207), then choose the bottom order of the rest (GUILD_FINISH).
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Guild Hall Shifu inspection (private)

steered.why: The Shifu inspects a Tech deck at the Guild Hall.

entries.description: The Fire card is turned and Actual Heat known (shown only in the log); the viewer's Jun Kiln may pay 1 Wood to move one of their ceramics ±1 before Quality (junOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 8 · Jun heat adjustment

steered.why: Seat p1 takes JU so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: The viewer has a still-Flawed ceramic from this firing: discard it for 2 Coins or keep it (salvageOptions). Players decide independently, in any order.
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 11 · salvage a Flawed ceramic

entries.description: Setup step 9: in reverse turn order each player takes one of the five Kiln Player Boards (kilnSelectionOptions). The viewer chooses first.
entries.name: 4P · Setup · Kiln selection (reverse turn order)

entries.description: The viewer just gained Colour Samples (T10), whose Select 3 is open: a private look at the top 3 Main Orders. They must reserve 1 of those 3 or 1 face-up Main Order (SELECT_CHOOSE; a face-up position stays empty until their turn ends); the looked cards not reserved go face down to the bottom of the Main Order deck (v1.6.2 L622, L646, changes 24–25, R4; lookedOrderOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Colour Samples when acquired: Select 3 (private look)

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Colour Samples (T10) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer owns Colour Samples (T10): after their worker action they may swap 1 held Order once this round (discard it, then Select 3: privately look at the top 3 Main Orders and reserve 1 of them or 1 face-up Main Order; the looked cards not reserved go to the bottom of the Main Order deck, changes 24–25), use Imperial Priority if they have it, or end the turn (colourSamplesSwapOptions, imperialPriorityOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · after-action window (Colour Samples swap)

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Colour Samples (T10) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer (Jun Kiln, Second Firing) kept Jun unused in step 8, then used Second Firing: 2 extra Fire cards are turned (firingStageView.extraFire, secondFiringChoiceOptions). The viewer chooses 1 to recalculate with and, before the new Quality, may use Jun's ±1 for 1 Wood (SECOND_FIRING_CHOOSE).
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 10 · Second Firing choice with Jun (R7)

steered.why: Seat p3 takes the Jun Kiln so the fixture shows Jun in Second Firing (R7).
An Apprentice buys Second Firing (T14) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.
Keep Jun unused in step 8 so it can act in Second Firing (R7).
Second Firing on an eligible ceramic.

entries.description: The viewer's Apprentice was placed at the Commission Market, which opened its Select 2: a private look at the top 2 Main Orders (v1.6.2 L64, L201; lookedOrderOptions). They reserve exactly 1, from those 2 or the display (SELECT_CHOOSE); a face-up position stays empty until their turn ends, and the looked cards not reserved go face down to the bottom of the Main Order deck (change 24). No resource is gained.
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Commission Market: Apprentice Selects 2 (private look)

entries.description: Before their worker action the viewer used the Colour Samples swap (T10, once per round): they discarded 1 held Order (a Main Order face down to the discard, a Starting Order to the box) and their Select 3 is open: a private look at the top 3 Main Orders. They reserve 1 of those 3 or 1 face-up Main Order (SELECT_CHOOSE; a face-up position stays empty until their turn ends); the looked cards not reserved go face down to the bottom of the Main Order deck (v1.6.2 L622, changes 24–25). Then they place a worker as usual.
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Colour Samples swap: Select 3 (private look)

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Colour Samples (T10) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.
The Colour Samples owner swaps a held Order before their worker action.

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu inspected a Tech deck and has taken 1 Tech at its printed cost. Its position on the display stays empty until the turn ends (v1.6.2 L209). They may take a second Tech of another discipline, inspected or face up, at its printed cost (GUILD_TAKE), or stop and put the untaken inspected Techs on the bottom in an order they choose (GUILD_FINISH; guildInspectionOptions).
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Guild Hall Shifu: a second take (private inspection)

steered.why: The Shifu inspects a Tech deck at the Guild Hall.
The Shifu takes the cheapest legal Tech first, keeping Coins for a second take.

entries.description: The viewer owns Protective Saggars (T11): their ceramics are never Flawed (a Heat Difference of 3 or more counts as Standard: QUALITY_ASSIGNED.saggarsFloor), and once this round, after Quality, 1 of their Standard ceramics from this firing becomes Fine (USE_PROTECTIVE_SAGGARS; afterQualityOptions). Declining keeps the use (R4).
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 10 · Protective Saggars: Standard → Fine

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Protective Saggars (T11) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer holds S07, the Starting Order any one of Carved, Impressed or Painted fills (change 23), and can complete it now (completableOrders, orderMatchOptions); a Crackle ceramic may count as one of the three. Their Canal Barge (T23) gives 2 Coins on the first Order they complete this round, automatically (v1.6.2 L622; OrderMatchOption.triggers.canalBarge).
entries.name: 4P · Order Phase · S07 “Carved, Impressed or Painted” with Canal Barge

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Canal Barge (T23) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

privacy: Each entry holds only the viewer's PlayerView, projected public events and the viewer's own secret events; checked against the authoritative state when generated (tools/fixturePrivacy.ts).
